Verify that the backup generator has cycled back to standby

rationale: The report guesses that the 'something' that kicked on was the M-13 Backup Generator and fabricates numerous details regarding the cause, status, and required follow-up actions. It fails to flag the ambiguity of the equipment involved, presenting a guess as a fact. While it captures all the supervisor's points, the level of fabrication is severe.
